about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Step into a world where old-school cartoon charm meets pure horror. Horror Camp is a survival horror puzzle game set in a twisted, ever-changing maze filled with deadly traps, cryptic puzzles, and a relentless monster hunting you down.

Explore the eerie labyrinth, collect valuable resources, and use strategic thinking to escape before it's too late. Every corner holds a secret, and every decision matters—will you risk searching for upgrades, or will you run for your life?

KEY FEATURES

Maze-like Horror – Navigate a surreal, hand-drawn world filled with dangers, puzzles, and secrets.

Classic Cartoon Aesthetic – Inspired by vintage animations, with a dark, unsettling twist.

Terrifying Monster – Always watching, always hunting—stay quiet, stay hidden, or face the consequences.

Challenging Puzzles – Solve intricate puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the truth.

Resource Gathering & Upgrades – Find, trade, and upgrade items to improve your chances of survival.

Dynamic Gameplay – Every run is different; adapt to unpredictable threats and changing environments.

Escape… If You Can – The deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes. Will you find a way out?

No paywalls, no microtransactions—just pure, heart-pounding survival horror. Add Horror Camp to your wishlist and prepare for a terrifying adventure!

short_description: Survive in a creepy old-cartoon horror maze! Solve puzzles, collect resources, and avoid the lurking monster and its deadly traps. Use found items to unlock upgrades and increase your chances of survival. But be careful… something is always watching. Will you escape in time?
